result:
Works correctly. Summary of the change:

- **`src/main.rs`**: `cmd_fmt` no longer re-parses the freshly written canonical text and compares it against the parsed input. That guard could only ever fire on a `write_surface` defect (never on user input), and it doubled the parse cost of every `fmt` invocation for a property already covered by `crates/smysl-core`'s test suite (`every_accepted_mutation_round_trips`, `versioning.rs`). `fmt` no longer emits exit code `9`; that code now belongs solely to `reindex --verify`.
- **`tests/cmd_fmt.rs`**: updated the trailing comment block that documented the now-removed guard.
- **Docs** (`CHANGELOG.md`, `ch01-03-foundations.typ`, `ch04-05-creating-formatting.typ`, `appendices.typ`): updated to describe the invariant as test-enforced rather than a per-run runtime check.

Both `cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast` pass. No commits were made, per instructions.
